donor_pool: same universal O/S/T/ST non-test intersection as v1

donor_selection.shortlist_rule: first 64 eligible donors in SHA256(target_sample_id|donor_sample_id) order after excluding same canonical video and, where possible, same environment
donor_selection.choice_within_shortlist: maximum symmetric Gaussian chroma distance using only global two-dimensional chroma mean/covariance statistics

transfer.gamut_handling: same radial chroma compression toward neutral

promotion_rule: Only if all quantitative and visual gates pass may naturalistic v2 be frozen for O/S/T/ST test evaluation.
